import bpy, os, base64
scene=bpy.context.scene
states={}
for c in bpy.data.collections:
    states[c.name]=(c.hide_render,c.hide_viewport)
    if c.name in {'01 ELEVADOR OFICIAL | esboco original','07 CHATGPT | estudo fachada superior 6 janelas','IMPORT_GITHUB_OFICIAL'}:
        c.hide_render=False;c.hide_viewport=False
    elif c.name.startswith(('02 ','03 ','04 ','05 ','06 ')) or c.name in {'Lacerda_Do_Zero','Lacerda_Upper_Blockout','ChatGPT_Visible_Test'}:
        c.hide_render=True;c.hide_viewport=True
cam=bpy.data.objects.get('CHATGPT | camera preview fachada')
assert cam
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
oldcam=scene.camera
old=(scene.render.filepath,scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage,scene.render.image_settings.file_format,scene.render.image_settings.quality,scene.render.engine)
root=r'C:\mcp-blender\blender_bridge\previews';os.makedirs(root,exist_ok=True)
out=os.path.join(root,'collab_facade_v2_tiny.jpg')
try:
    scene.camera=cam;scene.render.engine='BLENDER_WORKBENCH';scene.display.shading.light='STUDIO';scene.display.shading.color_type='MATERIAL';scene.display.shading.show_shadows=True;scene.display.shading.show_cavity=True
    scene.render.filepath=out;scene.render.resolution_x=200;scene.render.resolution_y=150;scene.render.resolution_percentage=100;scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG';scene.render.image_settings.quality=18
    bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True)
finally:
    scene.camera=oldcam
    scene.render.filepath,scene.render.resolution_x,scene.render.resolution_y,scene.render.resolution_percentage,scene.render.image_settings.file_format,scene.render.image_settings.quality,scene.render.engine=old
    for c in bpy.data.collections:
        if c.name in states:c.hide_render,c.hide_viewport=states[c.name]
with open(out,'rb') as f:b64=base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode('ascii')
with open(os.path.join(root,'collab_facade_v2_tiny_b64.txt'),'w',encoding='ascii') as f:f.write(b64)
print(f'V2_PREVIEW bytes={os.path.getsize(out)} base64={len(b64)}')
